guidebook.intro: Phone calls and messages are how plans get made. This unit also shows how Lusoga puts “me”, “you” and “him/her” inside the verb.

tips.title: Me, you, him inside the verb
body: The object goes inside the verb, between the person doing it and the verb stem: **n-ku-kubira** (I-you-call), **m-mu-kubira** (I-him-call).
For “me”, the marker is **n-**, and it changes the next sound like the n- for “I” does: **Nkubira** (call me), **Mpa** (give me), **Mpeereza** (send me).

culture.title: Beeping
body: Some people call and hang up after one ring, a “beep” or “flash”, meaning “call me back”. It saves airtime for the person who has less.
